definitions.rally_active: 从有效发球动作进入比赛起，至该分因落地、出界、下网或其他死球事件结束；不包含发球前准备。
definitions.non_play: 所有不属于有效回合的可用视频时间，包括发球前准备、回合后反应、捡球、交谈、等待、换边和暂停。

reviewed_boundary_policy.non_play_high_confidence: complement of [reviewed_start_ms - 250, reviewed_end_ms + 250] within the take
reviewed_boundary_policy.uncertain: the remaining transition intervals around reviewed starts and ends
reviewed_boundary_policy.short_rally_policy: boundary_only when no positive high-confidence interior remains

unreviewed_legacy_fallback.basis: rounded-up p90 absolute error from 255 reviewed legacy boundaries

excluded_policy.transition_windows: uncertain and masked from hard classification and boundary loss

sampling_policy.negative_sampling: sample across pre-rally, inter-rally and long-break regions; balance batches without discarding the full evaluation timeline

stage_2_taxonomy.status: requires additional labels or reviewed weak-label rules
stage_2_taxonomy.note: These classes are not treated as hard ground truth in stage 1 because only rally boundaries were manually reviewed.
